apps.name: Argus
apps.subtitle: Flipper Zero console and firmware
apps.description: Argus, Artifex's console for the Flipper Zero (built on qFlipper), with the Argus firmware for the device in one package. Update or repair the Flipper, mirror and control its screen, back it up, keep its captures in a local store, export them for Wireshark, and let Sarina reach the device through Argus's local control API. The firmware comes ready to install: in Argus, Install from file and choose /usr/share/argus/firmware/argus-firmware.tgz.
apps.note: Made by Artifex. For devices and systems you are allowed to test. The firmware's source: github.com/Artifex-Technologies/Argus_Firmware.
